# Session retrospective: turn pairing friction with marimo into improvements

Curated by Skill Harbor — @marimo-team's session-retrospective skill for the marimo-pair pairing workflow. After a pairing session, the skill helps a marimo team member review the conversation for friction — user frustration, inefficiency, errors, workarounds, context loss — present the friction points and let the user choose which to dig into. Root-cause discussion runs through seven lenses (skill structure, skill gap, misleading docs, API ergonomics, missing API, API bug, context window) and converges on a diagnosis; the default outcome is to capture it as an issue or discussion for the team to triage — never edit the skill or the underlying `marimo._code_mode` API without explicit user approval, and never auto-file. Honest caveats: written for the marimo team itself — the guardrails assume you're contributing to marimo-pair, so it's most useful to marimo contributors or anyone iterating on their own agent skills; strictly diagnosis, never authoring fixes. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
